feeds.title: The Comfy Cabin Blog » Trail Camera
feeds.description: Welcome to our woodland in the back of our cabin. Here you may see a variety of wildlife including birds, squirrels, deer, bears and much more! I'm Debra Roinestad, a city gal that moved to the woods along with my husband and two cats. So far, I have been enjoying the cabin life and I'm excited to share my adventures with you.

feeds.title: Joe's Trailcams
feeds.description: This site is about running trail cameras in South East Alaska and other outdoor activities. In his early 20s, Joe began hunting deer for food while a camera followed his move from Washington State to Alaska. For several years, he's been sharing his trail camera pictures, experiences, and advice on how to get the most out of trail camera use through social media.

feeds.title: Winterberry Wildlife Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to my educational program and blog on camera trapping and wildlife tracking. I'm Janet Pesaturo, and have led many tracking walks, and given several presentations on tracking and camera trapping. In 2018, I launched a guide book on Camera Trapping and I currently author the Winterberry Wildlife blog.
